title: 第三章 斩杀线恶魔！
slug: 电锯人开局契约斩杀线恶魔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“呃——！”

不再有开口的机会，言良倒在了地上，一声闷哼卡在喉咙里。左眼的视野先是变成了一片纯白的炫光，然后是灼烧般的剧痛从眼球内部向整个脑袋扩散，使得他流下了血泪。

然后是完全的黑，左眼已经消失。相应的，梦野那本应一无所有的眼眶之中长出了一颗新的眼睛。

“斯巴拉西！”梦野发出了愉悦的笑声，他用那新生的眼睛看着言良赞叹道：

“所谓世人，不就是你吗？”

“我曾对这句话嗤之以鼻。”

“但现在看来，加害者用受害者的眼睛来观察世界，没什么比这更美妙的了！”

“太宰治，你果然是对的！”

东山小红捂着脸，双肩剧烈地颤抖着，只敢透过指缝看着这一幕。她还想继续开口说些什么，但巨大的恐惧像一只大手掐住了她的喉咙，让她发不出一丝声音。

而她也知道，如果再来一次，她还是会做同样的选择。

她从小就是个胆小鬼。怕黑，怕鬼，怕打针，怕考试，怕跟陌生人说话，怕被老师点名……怕世界上一切可以害怕的东西，也怕一切不值得害怕的东西。

我知道这很卑劣，我真的是个人渣……

可是……可是我真的、真的好想活下去啊！哪怕只是一秒钟！

小红在心里责怨着自己。

如果可以的话，她也不想害人的！这种想法如毒蛇一样啃食着她仅存的怜悯心，让她都为自己那廉价的善良感到反胃。

大厅里陷入了死一般的寂静，所有人都在看着言良，等待着那无形的力量将他的脑袋斩下。

但是，一秒。两秒。五秒过去了。

除了言良粗重的喘息声，什么也没有发生。

他的脑袋，依然完好无损地长在脖子上！

“这？”言良摸了摸自己的脑袋，他不由自主地喃喃道：

“我还活着？！”

梦野的笑声忽然停了下来，倾着身子看向言良。

没有被斩首？在这个必死的局面里，居然有人活下来了？！

短暂的错愕过后，梦野激动得浑身都在发抖。他用力拍打着轮椅的扶手，那张满是烧伤的脸庞上，洋溢着如同沙漠难民终于寻觅到绿洲般的狂热。他朝着打手喊道：

“快！把他给我重新绑起来！不要伤害他！”

而就在这所有人都被惊呆的短短几秒钟里，低垂着头的言良，大脑正在飞快地运转。

自己没死，这只能证明一件事——那就是正如他刚才所推测的，夺走败者生命的，根本不是什么低级无能的赌博恶魔。在这栋大楼里，一定还有第二只恶魔！

但这只神秘的恶魔在哪里？为什么不以真面目示人？又为什么只是像个幽灵一样冷眼旁观这场赌局？

难道是……陷入了沉睡？

想要活下去，这是唯一的反击机会！

言良咬紧牙关，再次回忆起《电锯人》原著中的设定：人类的鲜血是恶魔的力量之源。既然血液能恢复恶魔的身体，那么，也必然可以唤醒沉睡中的恶魔！

言良的右眼盯着地面那些深不见底的裂缝，从赌局一开始他就注意到这些诡异的缝隙了。而眼看着打手朝他走来，这紧迫的局面已不容许他有任何迟疑。

Page (1/3)

"Uh-!"

With no chance to speak anymore, Yan Liang fell to the ground, a muffled groan stuck in his throat.The vision in his left eye first turned into a pure white glare, and then a burning pain spread from the inside of the eyeball to the entire head, causing him to shed tears of blood.

Then it was completely black and the left eye had disappeared.Correspondingly, a new eye grew in Mengye's eye socket that should have nothing.

"Sbarasi!" Mengye laughed happily. He looked at Yan Liang with his new eyes and praised:

"Isn't the so-called worldly person just you?"

"I laughed at that statement."

"But now it seems that the perpetrator sees the world through the eyes of the victim. There is nothing more wonderful than this!"

"Dazai Osamu, you are indeed right!"

Dongshan Xiaohong covered her face, her shoulders were shaking violently, and she could only watch this scene through her fingers.She wanted to continue to say something, but the huge fear grabbed her throat like a big hand, preventing her from making a sound.

And she also knew that if it happened again, she would still make the same choice.

She has been a coward since childhood.Afraid of the dark, afraid of ghosts, afraid of injections, afraid of exams, afraid of talking to strangers, afraid of being called on by the teacher... afraid of everything in the world that can be feared, and afraid of everything that is not worth fearing.

I know it's despicable, I'm really a scumbag...

But...but I really, really want to live!Even if it's just for a second!

Xiaohong blamed herself in her heart.

If possible, she wouldn't want to harm anyone!This thought was like a poisonous snake gnawing at her remaining compassion, making her feel sick to her stomach for her cheap kindness.

The hall fell into deathly silence. Everyone was looking at Yan Liang, waiting for the invisible force to chop off his head.

But, one second.Two seconds.Five seconds passed.

Nothing happened except Yanliang's heavy breathing.

His head is still intact on his neck!

"This?" Yan Liang touched his head and murmured involuntarily:

"Am I still alive?!"

Mengye's laughter suddenly stopped and he leaned forward to look at Yan Liang.

Not beheaded?In this fatal situation, someone actually survived?!

After a brief moment of astonishment, Mengye was so excited that his whole body was trembling.He slapped the armrest of his wheelchair hard, and his burned face was filled with the enthusiasm of a desert refugee who finally found an oasis.He shouted to the thugs:

"Quick! Tie him up again! Don't hurt him!"

And in the few seconds when everyone was stunned, Yan Liang lowered his head and his brain was running rapidly.

He is not dead, which can only prove one thing - that is, as he just speculated, the person who took the loser's life was not some low-level and incompetent gambling demon at all.There must be a second demon in this building!

But where is this mysterious demon?Why don't you show your true colors?And why are you just watching this bet like a ghost?

Could it be that... he fell into a deep sleep?

If you want to survive, this is your only chance to fight back!

Yanliang gritted his teeth and once again recalled the setting in the original work of "Chainsaw Man": human blood is the source of the devil's power.Since blood can restore a demon's body, it must also be able to awaken a sleeping demon!

Yanliang's right eye was staring at the bottomless cracks in the ground. He had noticed these strange cracks from the beginning of the gambling game.And seeing the thugs walking towards him, the pressing situation no longer allowed him to hesitate.
